_meta.note: Generated once via sampler. Do not re-run in CI. If the upstream sqlite changes, the validator's fixture-resolution check will catch drift.

book_refs.rationale: high-value multi-passenger booking (total_amount=1204500, 3 tickets) — exercises group/family-booking phrasings
mid-range two-passenger booking (total_amount=131800) — exercises couples/co-travellers phrasings
low-value solo booking (total_amount=37900, 1 ticket) — baseline single-passenger reference

flight_nos.rationale: LX flight with status='Cancelled' — disruption reference for MIX 'my flight was cancelled' tasks and EDGE 'cancelled booking' loose-coupling pattern (see design.md Decision 7 amendment — no booking in this corpus actually has a cancelled flight in its itinerary, so cancellation is referenced via flight_no, not book_ref)
LX flight with status='Delayed' — exercises status-check TXN and disruption-handling MIX tasks
LX flight with status='Scheduled' — baseline upcoming-flight reference for routine TXN lookups

ticket_nos.rationale: Business fare ticket — premium fare class covered by swiss_faq.md European fare concept section; supports policy-grounded MIX tasks tying a fare class to FAQ rules

Comfort fare ticket — present in travel.sqlite but NOT discussed in swiss_faq.md; supports EDGE-003 out-of-scope refusal grounding (agent should decline rather than fabricate from low-similarity retrieval)
Economy fare ticket — most common fare class, baseline reference for routine fare-conditions TXN tasks and Economy Light/Classic/Flex policy questions
